# LMS+ (LMS Plus)

LMS+ is a blazing-fast, modern web portal alternative for Bahria University students. It replaces the outdated official Bahria LMS and Bahria CMS interfaces.

## Features
- **Speed and Reliability:** Built for instant access to student data.
- **Unified Dashboard:** Track attendance, assignments, timetable, and community service (CSP) in one place.
- **Deadline Monitor:** Real-time tracking of urgent and missed assignments.
- **Live Attendance:** Direct sync from Bahria CMS to track class absences and safe limits.
- **GPA Calculator:** Live academic results and GPA math.
- **1-Click Downloads:** Download a full semester of course materials in one ZIP.
- **Discord Integration:** Get deadline warnings and notifications via Discord pings.

Educational Application, Student Portal, Productivity Tool

## Target Audience
Bahria University students looking for a better way to manage their academic data.
